title: With Jaylen Waddle trade, Dolphins have seven picks in first three rounds of 2026 draft

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: With Jaylen Waddle trade, Dolphins have seven picks in first three rounds of 2026 draft
sources.description: As the Dolphins look to build under new General Manager Jon-Eric Sullivan and head coach Jeff Hafley, they now have even more picks to do just that in the upcoming draft.
